usage: The word '兔' (tou3) is a noun used to refer to a rabbit, a common pet or animal.
'兔' can be used to talk about rabbits in general or a specific rabbit.
You can use '兔' as the subject or object in a sentence when discussing rabbits.
It often appears in everyday conversations about animals and pets.
'兔' can be combined with other words to describe different types of rabbits or rabbit-related things.
